545:t_010:0.en:
$$カスパー$$
「Too bad, $$ウェーバー$$... My range turned out to be just a little longer than your detection range.」

545:t_010:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Good work, $$カスパー$$. I'm glad I posted you there just in case.」

545:t_010:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm going to $$ヤムスク１１$$. You come with me.」

545:t_011:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「That was close, $c. It wasn't a bad plan.」

545:t_011:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「But our power always exceeds your expectations. It has until now... and it will from now on.」

545:t_012:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$レナード$$'s unit is heading for $$ヤムスク１１$$!」

545:t_012:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$ isn't responding!」

545:t_012:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Answer me, $$ウェーバー$$!」

545:t_012:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「No... It's not true, is it...」

545:t_012:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$アマルガム$$ reinforcements incoming!」

545:t_013:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「Like this, we can't chase $$レナード$$ or find out if $$クルツ$$ is safe...!」

545:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Are we in the palm of his hand...!」

545:t_013:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Didn't you decide you wouldn't give up!」

545:t_013:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $n are with $$テッサ$$! And it's not like $$クルツ$$ is definitely dead!」

545:t_013:5.en:
$$マオ$$
「What we have to do is get through this somehow!」

545:t_013:7.en:
$$マオ$$
(I won't let you love me and leave me, $$クルツ$$...! You're going to take full responsibility!)

545:t_014:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Any word from $$宗介$$ and the others!?」

545:t_014:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's no good! They don't respond to our transmissions either!」

545:t_014:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「There have been explosions at $$ヤムスク１１$$ for a while now...」

545:t_014:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Even if we wanted to check, with these guys around...!」

545:t_016:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Those guys attacked $$アマルガム$$, their own collaborators!」

545:t_016:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「They are targets of the purge.」

545:t_016:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Infighting is more than welcome, but do it big somewhere we're not around.」

545:t_017:1.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$ and I are both fine!」

545:t_017:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Captain has been evacuated! Launch the $$レーバテイン$$!」

545:t_019:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「What happened to $$クルツ$$? I'm not picking up his M9...」

545:t_019:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ウェーバー$$ is...」

545:t_019:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Talk later! First we take out the enemy in front of us!」

545:t_019:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$! Let's pick up where we left off!」

545:t_020:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You must have learned despair. Why do you fight?」

545:t_020:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't go deciding where we're headed on your own.」

545:t_020:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, but we're bad at giving up.」

545:t_020:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$始原の特異点$$... You are the ones who should learn to give up.」

545:t_020:4.en:
$$桂$$
「You're going to tell us too that we can't repair spacetime, right?」

545:t_020:5.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...Humans cannot change the world... or the past. $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ should know that as well.」

545:t_020:7.en:
$$桂$$
「Hold on, $$宗介$$. We'll take him on.」

545:t_021:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Let me teach you one important thing.」

545:t_021:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I have no intention of listening to optimism.」

545:t_022:0.en:
$$桂$$
「My name isn't $$始原の特異点$$! I'm... $$桂木桂$$!!」

545:t_022:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Let's go, $$オルソン$$! The two of us will take care of this crab!」

545:t_023:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Let me tell you, $$サイデリアル$$! I may not look it, but I'm a man who honors his debts!」

545:t_023:2.en:
$$桂$$
「If I'm the $$特異点$$ and I can save the world, I'll do it, no matter what anyone says!」

545:t_023:3.en:
$$桂$$
「If $$オルソン$$ and I aren't enough, I'll find that rumored third one!」

545:t_024:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just what you'd expect from a lady-killer who crossed spacetime. Moving that guy's heart is no small feat.」

545:t_025:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed: the Empire's forces have withdrawn.」

545:t_025:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Send the ground troops at once. Confirm Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$'s safety.」

545:t_026:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's the one! That one got $$クルツ$$...!」

545:t_027:0.en:
$$カスパー$$
「If you can see this woman, stop resisting.」

545:t_027:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What do you intend to demand, taking Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ hostage?」

545:t_027:5.en:
$$カスパー$$
「Mr. Ag... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ is requesting your cooperation.」

545:t_027:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In effect, a call for surrender...」

545:t_027:7.en:
$$カスパー$$
「Who knows... Ask him for the rest.」

545:t_027:8.en:
$$宗介$$
($$レナード$$... So this is how he eliminates us, the greatest obstacle to his ambitions...)

545:t_027:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(And now, losing the Captain means losing the means to stop $$レナード$$'s ambitions...)
